heading: Fields that update the page
body: Fields and methods belong to the service instance. A view reads them by the instance name: {counter.count}, on:click="counter.increment()". Template handlers and OnEvent methods refresh the view when they finish. Background work injects taskScheduler (Tachyon gives it to a field) and calls its render(). Fields marked @SessionState are saved to sessionStorage. Fields marked @LocalState are saved to localStorage. To save a change inside an array or object, assign a new value to the field.
